title: Maryland Homeowner Market Brief
summary: Where owner-occupied, higher-income households are concentrated in Maryland, ZIP code by ZIP code, and which ZIP codes hold homes valued under $400,000. Built to decide which ZIP codes to target or expand into for home and auto.

methods.title: Prime Targets
methods.text: At least 70% of occupied homes owner-occupied, median household income at or above the Maryland median ({stateIncome:money}), and at least 1,000 owner-occupied homes. Ranked by owner-occupied homes. Home value is shown as its own layer and is not part of the screen.

methods.title: Home Value
methods.text: What owners estimate their home would sell for (ACS tables B25075 and B25077). It includes land and is not replacement cost. The Census publishes value in fixed bands, so under $400,000 is exact; a band such as $300,000 to $700,000 is not available and the nearest is $300,000 to $749,999.

methods.title: Two Ownership Measures
methods.text: Homeownership rate: owner-occupied homes divided by occupied homes (B25003). Share of all homes owner-occupied: owner-occupied homes divided by all housing units (B25002). Seasonal market: 20% or more of all housing units vacant for seasonal, recreational or occasional use (B25004).

methods.title: Census Release
methods.text: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates, released December 2025. ZIP codes are 2020 Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas with more than half their land in Maryland; each is placed in the county with the most of its 2020 Census housing units. PO box ZIP codes have no residents and no Census profile.

methods.title: Precision
methods.text: Every value carries an ACS margin of error and is most reliable for larger ZIP codes. The Census top-codes income at $250,000 or more and home value at $2,000,000 or more. A blank value means the Census did not publish it, never zero.

methods.title: Regions
methods.text: Baltimore Metro, Capital Region, Southern Maryland, Western Maryland and the Eastern Shore, grouped by county. Region income is the household-weighted average of ZIP code medians.
